item.title: ECB Will Probably Have to Hike Interest Rates Again, Wunsch Says
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: The European Central Bank will likely need to raise interest rates further, according to Governing Council member Pierre Wunsch. “We are probably going to have to hike again,” the Belgian central-bank governor told Bloomberg Television on Wednesday. “But I’m not making any bet anymore because we have so much uncertainty on the energy front, maybe also AI.”
